title: USP of first world and the OG supreme A
textContentHtml:
1. A figures out how to imagine or live with the written character in a story! Maybe by using some kind of tech!

2. Absolutely using the current tech!

3. In this world A did not pursue the advance engineering but they had some better apportunities like fiction at that moment because major economies are growing because of content in this world!

4. And was always fascinated with the current development in tech and how people use it to consume the new era of fiction!

5. And in the advance fiction university he met F, B and H. 

6. He devoted his time in his free will character and later on understood the reality by himself! That he is a major character of this story!!!!!!

7. He tested it multiple times and every time it turned out to be in his favor!

8. But even he could not stop the unavoidable death of all his loved once!

9. And that's where he was avokened and even spread the knowledge to everyone!

10. Then he transferred all his knowledge to a selective A that was tweaked a little bit by the creator himself and this supreme A somehow sensed it;

11. So he transferrs all his memories and power/soul to him believing him that he could pass the test of the creator!

12. Then A suddenly wakes up in the class thinking it was all a dream but something was changed in this world!

13.
